summary: Iteration 9 testing complete. All 4 new features verified: (1) Guru dashboard scoping — /api/dashboard/guru returns class_students/total_assessments/total_tahfidz scoped to accessible classes (2 siswa, 4 tahfidz for wali 1A) vs admin school-wide counts. (2) is_wali flag on both /auth/login and /auth/me responses (true for demo guru, false for non-wali guru). (3) Sidebar 'Wali Kelas' group correctly hidden for non-wali guru, shown for wali guru (verified visually + DOM). (4) Kiosk NISN scan flow — kiosk-nisn-input + kiosk-nisn-submit present, no camera/video/Foto NISN, non-numeric chars stripped, submits on click and on Enter, result shows student name/class. Students & Teachers import upsert by NISN/NIP works (create-then-update flow, gender first-letter uppercased 'Perempuan'->P, class_name '1A' -> class_id mapping, is_wali_kelas 'Ya'->true). Export buttons trigger .xlsx download (data-siswa.xlsx / data-guru.xlsx). Regression: username login (admin/admin123) OK, guru sees only accessible classes in /api/classes.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; test writers must avoid -p no:xdist and use -n 0 for serial runs.
Kiosk.jsx keeps unused refs (nisnRef, useEffect video-related imports) — minor cleanup only.
routes_master.py import_students/teachers: no length cap on rows[] — could allow very large payloads; consider bounding to a few thousand for safety.
Login response uses 'access_token' key (not 'token') — worth documenting in api contract for testers.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (kiosk NISN + sidebar wali/non-wali + students/teachers export/import buttons)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily created user 'test_ui_nonwali' (non-wali guru) for sidebar test; deleted after test.
